name: plugin-split
title: Five sibling plugins, with the bundle as the only seam
outcome: A user installs one stage of the architecture lifecycle without the other three, and four independently-installed plugins write into one bundle without a stale copy destroying authored or paid content.
done_when: five plugin manifests validate, and cobuilder-full-lifecycle installs the other four
shared/ is vendored by symlink and an installed copy resolves it from its own cache
require_compatible() gates every script that writes into a bundle
bundle.json carries min_reader_schema and a generators map instead of one scalar
abort_if: the marketplace symlink dereference does not cover a directory of Python that a skill later runs, and the copy-before-publish fallback proves worse than staying one plugin

min_work.derived_from: 6 districts (skills, scripts, commands, viewer, docs, .cobuilder-architect), 4 related ADRs, 1 boundary rule on install surface

epics.note: One plugin becomes five. The whole packaging split: the mode renames inside today's single plugin, the deleted duplicate explore-design command, the 33 cross-pillar references, the five manifests, and the two ports. The rename is a rotation, not a split: odyssey submit becomes cobuilder-pr:generate, and the old odyssey generate, which narrates merged history, becomes cobuilder-pr:review. Four slices.

Shared code survives an install. Prove the marketplace symlink dereference, then vendor the four bundle modules and the two shared skills. One slice, because it is a spike whose result decides whether the rest of the design stands. goal.json.abort_if names its failure.
The seam is version-safe. require_compatible(), min_reader_schema, the generators map, bundle format 3, and schema 1.3, so two plugins at different versions cannot corrupt one bundle. Two slices.
The record index. build_index.py replaces the two projection scripts, emits every entity with a stable id, and resolves every join including an ADR to its pull request. Two slices.
One lifecycle surface. The Decisions, Contexts, and Builds modes, the Backlog lane, and moving generated pages out of the foreign directory into the bundle. Two slices (10, 11).
The reply channel. The append-only ledger and its projection, the anchor computed from the live DOM, the write endpoint, and the background wake command. Three slices (12, 13, 14).

Threads read as conversations. The drawer renders a reply under the comment it answers. Deferred past E6 on purpose: E6 ships the record shape, so this epic adds no migration and carries no slice yet.
